method: 15 scenarios passed in the final full run; the mouse-pause/input scenario passed in a targeted rerun after improving test scheduling for SwiftShader. Application build unchanged. Programmatic wheel cancellation uses a real DOM wheel event, followed by native wheel scroll; native scrolling and touch are also tested separately.

tests.title: native range, exact endpoints, reverse poses, scroll mapping and a single GLB request
slow and fast native scrolling, stop, reverse and on-demand idle rendering
story buttons move document, pause, reverse and yield to wheel and keyboard
Space on Pause stops without restarting, and Tab interrupts a story transition
manual mode preserves pose and camera, allows orbit and resumes at current manual progress
HTML labels follow visible nodes, stay outside the model, and selection includes all 47 groups
resize and orientation preserve progress and mode, with safe projected bounds
browser scroll restoration reloads the current story configuration
reduced motion defaults to compact manual mode and exact direct endpoints
loading HTTP failure has a working retry and no mandatory long story
unavailable WebGL retains a loaded fallback and disables 3D controls
WebGL context loss and restoration retain the current progress and mode
200% layout density, keyboard focus and touch target sizes
mobile touch / a vertical scene swipe scrolls the story and rotates only in manual mode
mobile touch / one mobile callout stays below the model; range tap and model selection work

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
environment.method: Chrome headless with ANGLE SwiftShader; viewport/touch emulation, not a physical phone or hardware GPU benchmark
